page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a storage-focused virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB per core.

A primary characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, consisting of 94,489 GB of local hard disk drive (HDD) storage. This large-capacity storage is bundled directly with the instance. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or GPU acceleration.

The hardware profile presents specific tradeoffs. While the local HDD storage offers exceptionally high capacity for data-dense workloads, HDD technology exhibits lower random read/write performance compared to solid-state drives (SSDs). Additionally, the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor represents an older CPU generation with a single thread per core configuration. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this instance delivers high storage density per resource unit, making it suitable for scenarios requiring vast storage volume without the premium cost of SSD arrays.

The ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is designed for workloads that require substantial local storage capacity and sequential data access. Suitable applications include large-scale data warehousing, log processing, MapReduce jobs, big data analytics, and cold storage archiving.
